Title: Best tonkotsu in town
Review: The tonkotsu broth was rich and creamy after what tasted like a very long simmer. Noodles had a perfect bite and the chashu melted in my mouth.

Title: Vegan ramen is real
Review: I am vegan and the mushroom miso ramen was fantastic. Deep umami broth, tofu was crispy, and the staff confirmed no animal products or fish stock.

Title: Queue out the door
Review: Food was great but we waited 50 minutes on a Friday night. They do not take reservations so go early.

Title: Too much salt
Review: The shoyu ramen was so salty I could not finish the broth. Noodles were good but the seasoning needs a lighter hand.

Title: Friendly staff
Review: Our server explained every topping and recommended the spicy miso. Water was refilled constantly. Lovely, attentive service.

Title: Cramped seating
Review: Tiny counter seats and tables packed close together. Not comfortable for a group larger than three, and bags have nowhere to go.

Title: Gyoza are a must
Review: Pan fried gyoza with a crunchy bottom and juicy pork filling. Order two plates, you will want them.

Title: Spicy but worth it
Review: The level 4 spicy miso had real heat and still kept its flavor. Level 5 is only for brave people.

Title: Kids menu available
Review: They have a mild chicken shoyu mini bowl for children and provided kid chopsticks and a bib. Noisy, but nobody minded.

Title: Overpriced extras
Review: Ramen is about 16 dollars, but an extra egg is 2.50 and extra chashu is 5. A fully loaded bowl hit 26 dollars which felt steep.

Title: Fast lunch
Review: Lunch special with ramen and a small rice bowl arrived within 8 minutes. Perfect for a work break and good value.

Title: Gluten free?
Review: I asked for gluten free noodles and was told they do not have them. The staff was honest, but there is little for celiacs here.

Title: Clean and modern
Review: Very clean open kitchen with wooden decor. You can watch the chefs work. Restrooms were spotless.

Title: Takeout broth separate
Review: Takeout came with broth and noodles packed separately so nothing got soggy. Very thoughtful packaging.

Title: Cold broth
Review: My bowl arrived barely warm and the egg was hard boiled rather than soft. The server took it back but the replacement took another 20 minutes.

Title: Great date spot
Review: Dim lighting and a small sake menu made this a nice date night. The matcha ice cream finished the meal well.

Title: Dessert disappointing
Review: Mochi ice cream was icy and hard in the center. Ramen was great, so skip dessert.

Title: Loyal regular
Review: I have eaten here every month for a year and the quality never changes. The owner remembers my order.

Title: Rude host
Review: The host ignored us for ten minutes and then told us to wait outside without giving an estimate. Felt unwelcome.

Title: Great vegetarian sides
Review: Edamame, seaweed salad and the vegetable gyoza are all vegetarian. Good choices for mixed diets.

Title: Loud music
Review: Food was delicious but the music was so loud we had to shout. Not ideal for conversation.

Title: Late night hero
Review: Open until 1 AM on weekends. A hot bowl of ramen after a concert was exactly what we needed.

Title: Portion size
Review: Generous noodle portion and you can get a free refill of noodles for the first round. Very filling.

Title: Allergy aware
Review: I have a peanut allergy and the staff checked with the kitchen and gave a clear answer. Felt safe eating here.

Title: Inconsistent
Review: My first visit was amazing, but the second time the noodles were overcooked and soft. Quality varies by night.

Title: Easy parking
Review: Small lot behind the building and street parking nearby. Gets full on weekends but we managed.

Title: Great value lunch
Review: The lunch combo is the best deal in the area and portions are large. Staff were quick and polite.
